lines.trans: Max, are you almost falling asleep?
No, I am simply admiring you.
Do you really love cooking so much?
Food is true love and passion!
You speak about food like a poet.
Good food gives people immense happiness.
At which restaurant is your interview?
In the very best French restaurant in Moscow.
Our city is full of surprising coincidences.
I am glad that I met you today.
Go to sleep, you need to rest well.
Good night, beautiful Vika.
Good night, my brave cook.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.en: to meet, to pick up (at a station)

examples.text: Меня никто не встретил на вокзале.
examples.trans: Nobody met me at the station.
I will meet you at the entrance.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of gift

examples.text: Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

examples.text: В этом ресторане всегда свежая еда.
examples.trans: There is always fresh food in this restaurant.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

ложиться.gloss: to lie down, go to bed

meanings.en: to lie down, go to bed
meanings.note: ложиться спать = to go to bed

examples.trans: Let's go into the ward, go to bed.
The children go to bed early.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

отдохнуть.gloss: to have a rest; to relax

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я не верю в такие совпадения.
examples.trans: I do not believe in such coincidences.
It is just a strange coincidence.
Happiness is getting closer, almost here!

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
The brave soldier defended the city.
There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
